questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring composition and framing. Annotate your process.

points.text: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to composition and framing, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with composition and framing. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.

points.text: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with composition and framing. Which approaches were most successful and why?

points.text: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

points.text: A grade 9 response will: demonstrate a range of compositional techniques; show deliberate viewpoint choices; annotate with compositional vocabulary (rule of thirds, leading lines, negative space); explain how composition creates MEANING, not just looks nice; evaluate which approach best serves the intention. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
